about: The review-class Bash fence's decision table: each command is piped through runtime/claude-code/hooks/review-bash-guard.sh as a PreToolUse payload and its decision read back (deny, or allow: the command rewritten to run with a clean environment and no decision, or no output for a payload without a command). Read by tests/test_review_bash_guard_cli.py. A case is added with the review that found it; a refusal on purpose names the spelling that works.

sections.section: shell escapes, path-qualified git and in-place writes are denied
the environment and secret material are denied (2026-10-04: a reviewer printed the signing key)
…and the routine spellings two blind reviews of #96 found past the first version

cases.label: denied: a search naming a /proc environ path (indistinguishable from reading it)

sections.note: A search naming a /proc/*/environ path reads it as surely as cat does: the guard cannot tell a pattern from a file argument there, so it is refused (search for "environ" instead). The other secret words stay searchable as patterns.
